name: Track #59
description: Humans Part 3 is the next generative audiovisual project with layered audio tracks that combine the new 7 Characters: Cubismo, Sandra, Toothless Dude, Mr. Frankie, Merlin, Dennis Singer, and Prince of Sound. Together, these seven characters created music that was truly unique. Their styles blended together seamlessly, creating a sound that was both familiar and new.
